answer.answer: Both the ICAR Junior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences [E01] and the ICAR Senior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences [E02] list Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) as one of the Central Universities having faculty of agriculture where candidates can pursue their respective Master's degree and Ph.D. programs to receive these fellowships.

claim_to_evidence.claim: ICAR Junior Research Fellowship accepts admissions at Aligarh Muslim University (AMU)
ICAR Senior Research Fellowship accepts admissions at Aligarh Muslim University (AMU)
